proxy.comment: Local proxy (ClashX / Surge / v2rayN / FastLink etc.). url is preferred; with auto_detect on, the switcher verifies it at launch and otherwise falls back to the OS system proxy, then scans common local ports — no manual edit needed when you swap proxy apps
proxy.candidates_comment: Optional extras, e.g. candidates: ["http://127.0.0.1:18080"], candidate_ports: [18080]. Built-in scan already covers 7897/7890/7892/7893/7899/7895/10809/2080/2081/8080/20171/20172

path.comment: Extra dirs appended to PATH when launched by double-clicking a .command (Finder-spawned shells may lack /usr/sbin, so lsof and self-managed node are invisible). Example: ["/Users/you/.nvm/versions/node/v22.11.0/bin"] — node >= 21 is required by recoverWhiteScreen

markers.comment: Marker files live under $HOME and toggle proxy per tool

opencode.comment: CLI binary name on PATH; desktop = Electron app in /Applications

antigravity.comment: UI 是 https://127.0.0.1:<port> 回环。language_server(Go) 启动需 ~37s(playwright 404 重试等)，窗口过早加载会 30s 超时白屏；recoverWhiteScreen=true 时启动器等 LS 就绪后经 CDP 重载窗口。chromiumArgs=--no-proxy-server 防御系统 PAC(wpad NXDOMAIN) 劫持 Chromium 回环代理解析。API 流量仍走 language_server(Go, 吃 HTTPS_PROXY env)
